description: Recreates the user-defined hole-pattern branch of C:Flange (Flange.lsp) — draws a circular or angled/elliptical bolt-hole pattern on a pitch circle diameter, headless.

inputFile.description: Any blank/template drawing. FLANGE draws entirely from params.json and never reads pre-existing entities, so no special seed drawing is required.

params.description: HolePatternInput JSON — Offset/FlangeTangentAngleDegrees/PatternDiameter/NumberOfHoles/HoleDiameter/CenterX/CenterY/RotationAngleDegrees. See Models/HolePatternInput.cs and params.schema.json.

outputFile.description: Same drawing, saved in place after drawing the hole pattern. Shares input.dwg's localName deliberately — QSAVE writes back to the file accoreconsole already has open.
